# YT6 — Use Cases

YT6 provides clarity, stability, and reproducibility testing for:

## 1. AI Agents
Test multi-turn stability and drift.

## 2. LLM Evaluation Teams
Measure reproducibility and clarity under pressure.

## 3. Research Labs
Benchmark drift, variance, and stability.

## 4. Enterprise AI Teams
Validate reasoning consistency.

## 5. AI Safety Groups
Detect clarity collapse and drift injection.
